description: This file defines classes related to RTP (Real-time Transport Protocol) socket handling for Bluetooth audio streaming, including MediaPacket, OutboundMediaPacketType, and ClientSocket classes, with methods for packet packing, unpacking, serialization, and socket state management.

classes.name: MediaPacket
classes.description: Represents an RTP media packet with methods for packing, unpacking, and accessing packet data.

classes.name: OutboundMediaPacketType
classes.description: Template class for outbound RTP media packets, providing ingestion and serialization functionalities.

classes.name: ClientSocket
classes.description: Abstract class for Bluetooth RTP client socket handling, managing socket state and MTU configuration.

methods.name: Pack
methods.description: Serializes payload data into an RTP packet buffer using codec information.

methods.name: Unpack
methods.description: Decodes RTP payload data into raw audio data using codec.

methods.name: Ingest
methods.description: Ingests raw audio data into the RTP packet for transmission.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes RTP packet data into a stream for sending over network.

methods.name: Operational
methods.description: Sets the operational state of the socket (up or down).
